article.title: Feature Importance Is Not a Business Driver: Reading SHAP Without Overclaiming Causality
article.why: Practical analytical English for data-driven decisions.

paragraphs.en: SHAP values explain how a predictive model distributes credit among features for a prediction. They can show that a customer received a high score partly because recent spending was high, app usage increased, or a category was frequently purchased. What SHAP does not establish is that changing one feature will cause the business outcome to change. A propensity model learns statistical patterns that predict an outcome. A feature can be highly predictive because it is a proxy, a consequence of another process, or correlated with the true driver. Frequent hospital-related purchases might predict interest in insurance, but that does not prove that encouraging hospital purchases would increase demand. Prediction and causation answer different questions. Correlated features create another challenge. When two variables contain similar information, attribution can be distributed between them in ways that depend on the model and SHAP method. A low SHAP importance for one feature does not necessarily mean the underlying business concept is unimportant. A high global mean absolute SHAP value indicates contribution to model predictions, not a guaranteed lever for action. A safer workflow has three layers. First, describe predictive evidence: which features influence the score and in what direction. Second, propose a business mechanism explaining the association. Third, test an actionable causal hypothesis using an experiment or appropriate causal design. Local explanations also need care. A positive SHAP value means the feature pushed model output upward relative to the chosen baseline. It does not mean the feature increased the customer’s real-world probability by the same amount. Interpretation depends on whether output is a raw score, log-odds, or calibrated probability. In business communication, say the model uses recent category activity as an important predictive signal rather than recent category activity causes conversion. If the signal suggests a campaign idea, label it as a hypothesis, define the intervention and outcome, and specify evidence that would confirm or reject the mechanism. SHAP is powerful because it makes complex models easier to inspect. Treat it as a bridge from prediction to hypothesis generation, not automatic proof of a business driver. Analysts should document the population, observation window, assumptions, and operational definition before drawing a business conclusion. A useful review separates the observed metric, the possible mechanism, and the action that follows from the evidence. This makes the analysis easier to reproduce, challenge, and communicate to stakeholders. paragraphs.zh: 繁中完整解說：本文逐步區分觀察到的數據、可能的商業機制與可支持的結論，避免把相關性、資料邊界或模型輸出直接當成因果事實。核心實務原則是先定義母體、期間與決策目的，再選擇合適的指標、實驗設計或解釋方式，最後把證據強度與下一步行動清楚連結。
paragraphs.ja: 日本語完全訳：本文は、観測されたデータ、考えられるbusiness mechanism、証拠から支持できる結論を分けて考える。相関、データ範囲、model outputをそのまま因果事実として扱わず、対象母集団・期間・意思決定目的を先に定義する。そのうえで適切な指標、実験設計、説明方法を選び、証拠の強さと次のactionを明確につなげることが実務上の要点である。
